differences.explanation: Pinned byte decoder accepts surrogate byte encodings; compiler pipeline rejects invalid decoded UTF8 with SyntaxError8452. No new UTF8 validation is imposed on the decoder.
Compiler accepts empty assembly flag; pinned asm classification has an unchanged source-length>2 and refuses it. Base solc-alignment claim is disproved by this observation.
Compiler accepts single-quoted memory-safe flag; pinned asm classification has an unchanged double-quote-only and refuses it. Base solc-alignment claim is disproved by this observation.
